Team —

Quick leadership check-in ahead of next week's Q2 readout. I want a tight, account-by-account sanitation sweep so we can present a clean runway and explicit OKR tie-ins to the board. High-level asks (please read all and reply with owner confirmation):

1) Per-account snapshot (use attached account-sanitation-template.xlsx): current ARR/ARR motion, open next-step, procurement ETA if any, and delta vs. our last forecast.
2) Confidence bucket: (High / Medium / Low) and a 1-line rationale — this will feed the deck's confidence heatmap.
3) OKR mapping: which company OKR does each account materially affect (revenue, retention, platform adoption).
4) Owner assignments + 48h action: who will own the follow-up to lock dates or remove runway.

Please prioritize strategic and at-risk deals. Tessa — take the top 10 strategic accounts and produce short 1-paragraph owner briefs. Rishi — can you consolidate the rollup and produce a delta table showing changes to committed/likely over the last 14 days? Laura — once we have owner briefs, please coordinate 1:1 confirmation with procurement or legal for any external blockers (I want explicit delivery dates or a named blocker). Aditya — flag any contractual exceptions we should escalate to legal/finance.

Deliverables due by EOD Tuesday (2028-06-16) so we can lock the readout. I attached the template and an example row. Keep notes terse — this goes straight into the leadership packet.
